svg.title: Boost and Schlegel projection
svg.desc: The (x, w) plane before and after a Lorentz boost, hyperbolas of constant interval, and the tesseract's Schlegel projection at four XW rotations.
svg.text: A boost slides along hyperbolas; a rotation turns the tesseract inside out
top: (x, w) in units of 30 CPU-seconds and 30 seconds; bottom: the view's projection, violet = edges along w, orange = the cell at w = +1, blue = the cell at w = -1
boosted: rest frame of the 0.6-core process
light cone unchanged; the 0.6 worldline is vertical; 'now' tilts
